answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric anchoring provides an oasis of security in decentralized AI networks. By requiring agents to cryptographically bind their identity to a unique physical substrate, the protocol treats digital identity like copper wire connecting to reality. An attacker attempting to scale fake accounts must procure physical hardware for each new node, turning a boundless meadow of virtual identities into a high-cost capital expenditure that renders mass Sybil deployment economically irrational.
